title: BC Municipal Solid Waste Disposal Rates, by regional district, 1990–2024
publisher: Government of British Columbia, BC Data Catalogue
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia
definition: kg of municipal solid waste disposed per person per year (Disposal_Rate_kg); a disposal rate, NOT a diversion rate, and lower is better
caveats: a year with 0 tonnes disposed is a missing report, not zero waste (Central Coast 2024: 0 t after ~1,600 t a year; 1990s rows: 0 t and no population): the stories read it as no data and say so
Comox-Strathcona and Northern Rockies are reporting units, not regional districts (see geo-bc-waste-units.source.json)
